title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: AI email classification by category and subcategory
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, opt-in setup, billing prerequisite and documented controls are supported. The taxonomy path stops just before the Add button, and the form-customisation checklist step has no corresponding control row; both are minor findings.

claims.claim: Dynamics 365 Customer Service adds AI classification of inbound emails using administrator-defined categories and subcategories.
claims.quote: With email classification, administrators can define a custom taxonomy of categories and subcategories to automatically classify inbound emails in Dynamics 365 Customer Service.
